title: Establishing a preoperative predictive model for gallbladder adenoma and cholesterol polyps based on machine learning: a multicentre retrospective study.
summary: The multicenter model distinguishes pathology-confirmed gallbladder adenomas from cholesterol polyps and has internal/external cohort evaluation; the linked correction changes funding disclosure only, not the represented result. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
ai_technology: primary cohort 1,009 (706 training/303 internal) plus 139 external; 12 algorithms/110 combinations, SVM+RF AUC .972/.922; diagnosis based on postoperative pathology. Publisher correction DOI 10.1186/s12957-025-03724-2 states only funding acknowledgement correction, no result change.
